Please find attached Finova's first-pass redlines on Redwood's DPA (Finova_DPA_Redlines_R1.docx). Our counsel flagged three areas that need clarification before we can proceed to execution:

Ben / Grace / Kim — my notes below after an initial read of Finova's R1. Attached a short annotated PDF (RI_Annotated_Redlines_R1.pdf) and a draft response.

1) Subprocessors: Finova's proposed right-to-review for "high-risk" subprocessors is broad. We can offer a compromise:
   - Confirm 30-day notice for changes and a 10-business-day review window for customers to request additional info.
   - For high-risk categories (data residency, human reviewers, specialized PCI-like processing) offer a right to "request further information" rather than unilateral veto.
   - We will provide an up-to-date Exhibit S at signing and a quarterly subprocessor notification feed (CSV).

2) Transfers: Counsel prefers SCCs + an EU-US Transfer Addendum. Redwood standard is: we apply SCCs where required and provide a narrow EU-US Addendum for customers who request explicit language. Recommend we accept SCCs + addendum for Finova (no privacy policy reliance). This will satisfy their counsel and keeps our operational model intact.

3) Evidence: We can provide our SOC 2 Type II attestation, a redacted subprocessor map for the last 12 months, and a short attestation letter for each named subprocessor that handles Finova data. Some subprocessors (third-party cloud infra) will be covered by SOC reports; others may provide security questionnaires.

4) Execution flow / eSign: propose single DocuSign envelope that includes (a) Main DPA, (b) Exhibit S (current snapshot), and (c) Transfer Addendum if selected. I can coordinate a DocuSign envelope once we lock redlines. I created a draft envelope link for discussion: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/0123456789

Next steps I recommend: Grace to confirm legal redlines we cannot accept; Ben to confirm timing with Finova Procurement; I will prepare the Exhibit S and evidence package.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: RI_Annotated_Redlines_R1.pdf; Subprocessor_Inventory_QA.xlsx
